senses.gloss: m. (στρατιώτης) prop. soldier, later Roman officer (D. C. Gr. s. v.); attendant.
units: <cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Shekalim 5:1:22">Y. Shek. V, 49ᵃ</cite>; <cite ref="Shir HaShirim Rabbah 3:6">Cant. R. to III, 6</cite>, end <cite ref="A02415"><he>אסטרטיג</he></cite> (corr. acc.). Y. Keth. I, 25ᶜ top <he>טיוס …</he> (corr. acc.).—Pl. <cite ref="A02417"><he>אִסְטְרַטְיוֹטִין</he></cite>.

<cite ref="Targum of I Chronicles 18:6">Targ. I Chr. XVIII, 6</cite> (v. however <cite ref="Targum Jonathan on II Samuel 8:6">Targ. II Sam. VIII, 6</cite>). Tanḥ. Haăz. 2, read: <he>באו א׳</he> the officers came to meet the king.—<he>אִסְטְרַטְיוֹטוֹת</he>.
<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Bava Kamma 4:3:3">Y. B. Kam. IV, 4ᵇ</cite> top <he>ששליח המלכות שני א׳</he> (read <he>ששלחה</he>) the Roman governm. sent two commissioners.
<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Nedarim 11:12:2">Y. Ned. XI, 42ᵈ</cite> bot. <he>אסטרטיות</he>; v. <cite ref="A02413"><he>אִסְטְרַטְיָא</he> II</cite>.
